items: The branch manager prepared the revised staffing plan ____ before presenting it to headquarters.
The subject and the emphatic pronoun refer to the same person; 'herself' emphasizes that the manager personally prepared the plan.
Employees can register ____ for the safety workshop through the intranet.
The employees are both the people acting and the people being registered, so the reflexive pronoun 'themselves' is required.
Mr. Chen introduced ____ to the visiting auditors before the meeting began.
The subject 'Mr. Chen' and the object refer to the same person, so 'himself' is required.
I checked the final invoice ____ to make sure no charges were duplicated.
The reflexive/emphatic pronoun 'myself' emphasizes that the speaker personally checked the invoice.
The software automatically restarts ____ after the update is installed.
The software is both the subject and the thing being restarted, so the reflexive pronoun 'itself' is required.
Please help ____ to coffee and snacks in the lounge before the seminar starts.
The fixed expression 'help yourself to' requires the reflexive pronoun 'yourself' when addressing one person.
The technicians completed the calibration ____ rather than hiring an outside contractor.
'Themselves' emphasizes that the technicians personally completed the work.
Ms. Patel reminded ____ to attach the signed contract before sending the email.
Ms. Patel is both the person reminding and the person being reminded, so the reflexive pronoun 'herself' is required.
We designed the customer survey ____ and then asked the research firm to distribute it.
'Ourselves' emphasizes that 'we' personally designed the survey.
The new interns introduced ____ to everyone in the department on their first morning.
The interns are both the subject and the people being introduced, so 'themselves' is required.
The CEO ____ will announce the acquisition during tomorrow's press conference.
The emphatic reflexive pronoun 'herself' can follow 'the CEO' to stress that she personally will make the announcement.
After reviewing the instructions, you should be able to install the application by ____.
The expression 'by yourself' means without assistance and requires the reflexive pronoun 'yourself'.
The committee members divided the remaining tasks among ____ before leaving the meeting.
Because the committee members distribute tasks among the same group, the reflexive pronoun 'themselves' is required.
Mr. Lopez found ____ responsible for coordinating three client visits on the same day.
The subject and complement refer to the same person in 'found himself responsible', so 'himself' is required.
The printer shuts ____ off automatically after thirty minutes of inactivity.
The phrasal construction refers back to the subject 'printer', so 'itself' is required.
I will speak with the supplier ____ if the delivery problem is not resolved today.
'Myself' is used emphatically to stress that the speaker personally will speak with the supplier.
The consultants gave ____ enough time to review the financial records before drafting the report.
The consultants are both the giver and recipient of the allotted time, so 'themselves' is required.
Before operating the machine, familiarize ____ with the emergency-stop procedure.
The verb pattern 'familiarize yourself with' requires the reflexive pronoun 'yourself'.
The hotel owner renovated the lobby ____ instead of using a design agency.
'Herself' emphasizes that the hotel owner personally performed the renovation work.
The two departments reorganized ____ after the merger was completed.
The departments are the entities acting on themselves, so the reflexive pronoun 'themselves' is required.
The director asked whether the applicants had prepared the presentation slides ____.
'Themselves' emphasizes that the applicants personally prepared the slides rather than someone else doing so.
Our team assembled the exhibition booth ____ to reduce setup costs.
'Ourselves' emphasizes that the team personally assembled the booth.
The applicant described ____ as an experienced project coordinator during the interview.
The subject 'applicant' and the object of 'described' refer to the same person, so 'herself' is required.
You may find ____ working with colleagues from several different time zones.
In the pattern 'find yourself doing something', the subject and object are the same person, so 'yourself' is required.
The laboratory developed the testing procedure ____ rather than licensing one from another company.
'Itself' emphasizes that the laboratory developed the procedure independently.
